_notes: Which model does which AI task. provider: ollama (local Qwen etc.), openai (LM Studio / llama.cpp / vLLM), anthropic (Claude, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Tasks: choose, pick-fields, draft-body, explain (plain-language open items in the run summary), mail (the email composer chat), part-chat (the Part inspector's chat). An example folder can override this with its own ai.json. Turn the AI on per run with --ai or the Options menu.
